title: Publish generalized system planning options and security-model documentation
instruction: Rename the public scenario surface to system planning options without limiting the method to HPCI, annotate HPCI-specific constraints at the relevant plan elements, add a concise public overview using natural Japanese for update and verification status, show each option as a versioned quarter-based implementation path that can change over time, and publish the public Research Web security model while clearly separating repository validation from platform-enforced network controls.
